about: You're an imprisoned dictator. People come to visit you and express their feelings about your rule. The worst thing is...
Some of them you certainly know.
- 5 new characters with their own painful stories based on real events
- Some secrets from the metaphysical realm
- Violence toned down compared to the basic edition

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
